ru.name: Абсолют: Пение ветра

tooltip: Урон от удара в режиме фантомного меча: 1150% x 1, до 2 уд.
(Эффект не действует в режиме Фантомного меча )

en.name: Absolute: Carver
en.description: Preceding Skill: [Carver III] Dash towards enemies to cut them down by attacking their weak spots.
en.command: Hold {KeyBind:Dash} + {KeyBind:Attack1} during Slice Hold {KeyBind:Dash} + {KeyBind:Attack1} while sprinting Hold {KeyBind:MoveFront} + {KeyBind:Dash} + {KeyBind:Attack1} Can be added to a Quick Slot Can be used with Tiger Blade drawn
tooltip: Tiger Blade attack damage 1150% x1, max 2 hits
